workload: one display-safe ASCII block per round, with the requested body-line count, written once to the owned pane terminal

parameters.sampling: serial rounds; one persistent watcher and a freshly armed capture poller per round

semantics.scope: same multiline block and start clock, with observer scheduling and 10 ms capture polling included
semantics.transform: event CRLF to LF only; no trimming or case folding within the compared block
semantics.event: first callback completing the end marker; the accumulated exact canonical block must match
semantics.start: monotonic timestamp before one write of the payload plus LF to the owned pane PTY
semantics.effectiveRate: exact canonical payload bytes divided by start-to-complete time for each observer; includes producer, tmux, scheduling and capture polling; not raw transport throughput
semantics.capture: first complete-history rendered capture containing the end marker; the exact block must match
